card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, then shoes, then keys. You've picked up the keys before we've had tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we especially need the usual order. Otherwise we'll forget the tickets too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the tickets while you drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put them down. Tea first. If we start doing two steps together, we'll spend the whole journey wondering what we missed.
